page_title: Iteration Layer is now Task Machine

sources.entry: Iteration Layer - Composable content processing APIs for document extraction, image transformation, and image, document & sheet generation.

summary.name: Task Machine (formerly Iteration Layer)
summary.one_liner: Iteration Layer, a European AI worker infrastructure and composable content-processing API, has shut down, and its team now builds Task Machine, a platform for running recurring work as controlled AI agent workflows.
use_cases: adding human approvals to agent work
capping AI agent spending per job
auditing what an AI agent did in a run
running agents on existing ChatGPT or Copilot subscriptions
summary.what_it_does: The page announces that Iteration Layer, which offered European AI worker infrastructure and APIs, has been wound down and its APIs are no longer available. The same team now builds Task Machine, described as a different product for recurring work. Task Machine turns repeated jobs into steps with owners, schedules, approvals, checks, and retries. Approvals, questions, blockers, and results are gathered in one inbox-style place. Runs use existing model subscriptions such as ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot, and each decision, tool call, retry and cost is recorded in a single audit trail. Schedules and spending limits can be set per job.
notable: Iteration Layer APIs (document extraction, image transformation, document and sheet generation) are discontinued
Task Machine runs agents on existing ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot subscriptions
Per-job schedules, spending limits and approval requests sent to inbox
Seven-day trial offered for Task Machine
caveats: Iteration Layer's APIs are no longer available; the page is a shutdown notice and Task Machine is described as a different product, not a continuation.
Task Machine is offered with a seven-day trial; the page does not state ongoing pricing, so paid terms are unknown.
